artifacts.evidence: no computational change inside the producing script's import closure; changes elsewhere or documentation-only

Computational changes in the closure: src/aaf/data.py (existence checks that raise when an input file is missing, and a download-time comparison with the recorded French snapshot) and src/aaf/leaf.py (the face minimum-variance routine is now an exact support enumeration instead of a projected gradient capped at 5,000 steps). Parity reruns of all six forest runs with the release code in a scratch copy on 2026-09-25 (the two French finals as parity checks only; recorded results untouched), instrumented to log every call of the changed routine: archival development (both formulations), French development (equality) and French final (equality) byte-identical in every result file except run timings; French development and final with the relaxed leaf identical except round-off in two seeds' weights (at most 2.2e-16) and, in development, block Sharpe ratios (at most 4.3e-14). The routine was reached only on two- and three-asset faces with exactly tied means (11 to 6,439 calls per run), where old and new weights agree to 1.3e-12.
